roles.title: Customer Support Specialist
roles.summary: Answers customers by chat, email and phone, resolves or escalates issues in a ticketing tool, and keeps records. A common entry point into customer success, technical support and operations.
roles.overlap_note: Overlaps customer-success (account management) and it-sysadmin 'help desk' titles; resolve by JD keywords: 'renewal', 'QBR', 'health score' -> customer-success; 'tickets', 'queue', 'SLA' -> this role. Needs check: Aliases are O*NET 'sample of reported job titles' (short titles only). jd_keywords are Skillstack wording from the task lists, needs review against real postings.
roles.suggested_path_note: Auto-ranked by skill weight, role tag and certificate recognition. A starting point for the plan builder, not a final plan.

roles.title: Technical Support Specialist
roles.summary: First and second line support for software or devices: reproduce issues, troubleshoot by following runbooks, log tickets and escalate to engineering. Bridges customer service and IT operations.
roles.overlap_note: Close to it-sysadmin ('IT Support / Junior Sysadmin') and technical-operations. Proposed split: internal IT/infrastructure -> it-sysadmin; customer/application-facing troubleshooting -> this role. Owner may prefer to merge it into it-sysadmin. Needs check: Aliases are O*NET sample titles plus two Skillstack additions (Technical Support Engineer, Application Support Analyst) that need check. Alias(es) Technical Support Specialist left out because another role already uses them.

roles.title: Procurement Specialist / Buyer
roles.summary: Finds and evaluates suppliers, issues requests for quotes and purchase orders, negotiates terms and tracks orders in an ERP. Common route into supply chain and operations.
roles.overlap_note: Overlaps supply-chain-analyst ('Procurement Analyst', 'Purchasing Coordinator' are aliases there). Owner decision: split or merge. Needs check: ESCO match is a manager occupation (1324.3.4.2); used for skills only. O*NET Job Zone is 4, so entry-level postings may be titled 'Purchasing Coordinator' or 'Buyer I' (needs check). Alias(es) Purchasing Coordinator left out because another role already uses them.
